scenarios.description: One entry per risk scenario priced.

opencrq_id.description: The OpenCRQ scenario id, empty for a draft.

asset.description: The primary asset or business service at risk.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the figures as OpenCRQ prices them (the original currency).

threshold_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the organization's thresholds; null when the profile has no currency.

fx_rate.description: Units of threshold_currency per unit of currency, from the profile's reference rates; null when none.

fx_rate_date.description: The date the reference rate was published (YYYY-MM-DD).

fx_source.description: Who published the reference rate, as the profile names it.

above_approval_threshold.description: Compared in threshold_currency only; null when no comparison is possible (no rate, no currency or no threshold).

draft.description: True when the scenario is not yet in OpenCRQ.
